title: From Search Dynamics to Semi-Ideal Computers — Part I
subtitle: Theorem Mazes, Certified Settlement, and Feedback Control
desc: Corrected and expanded foundations of rational theorem mazes, typed settlement, verified-history SICs, safe quotienting, and feedback control. Historical experiments remain explicitly limited.

title: From Search Dynamics to Semi-Ideal Computers — Part II
subtitle: The Geometry of Incomplete Proof Knowledge: Certified Envelopes, Active Discovery, and Reliable Feedback
desc: Certified inner and outer proof-graph envelopes, optimality certificates, active discovery, embedding stability, and reliable feedback. A 64-case synthetic experiment compares fixed-order and geometry-guided edge queries; no real ATP speedup is claimed.
